entries.title: Manage your fleet
entries.description: Maintain machines, categories and implements, assign drivers, and record service intervals and category rates. Retire fleet items while keeping their history.

entries.title: Resolve hour reading exceptions
entries.description: Review disputed machine hours and photo verification warnings. Inspect photos, recheck verification, and correct or confirm readings with a recorded reason.

entries.title: Organise customers and work types
entries.description: Maintain customer contact details and their farms. Add work types and deactivate those no longer offered.

entries.title: Filter users by business access
entries.description: See whether each user has Equipment access, Contracting access, both or neither. Combine Mode filters to narrow the user list.

entries.title: Switch between businesses reliably
entries.description: Users with access to both businesses can switch between Equipment and Contracting from the sidebar without an error.

entries.title: Find machines in the field
entries.description: Search machines by code, filter by category, and view their latest synced hours and reading history. Fleet details and histories opened while connected remain available offline.

entries.title: Capture machine hours offline
entries.description: Type hour meter readings and optionally attach a photo, even without signal. Captures stay saved on your phone and sync when the app is open with a connection.

entries.title: Resolve queued reading problems
entries.description: Use Needs attention to review captures that could not sync. Dispute an incorrect previous reading, retry syncing or discard a capture.
